ValidationRule.description: Scheduled date must be at least 2 days in the future when schedule is being locked. Enforces 48-hour dispatch lead time per LOVING Full Process Guide (Phase 3, Stage 7).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Schedule_Locked__c), Schedule_Locked__c = TRUE, NOT(ISBLANK(Scheduled_Date__c)), Scheduled_Date__c < (TODAY() + 2) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Scheduled Date must be at least 2 days from today before the schedule can be locked.
